item.text:
The next investigation found another recovery defect, plus an important negative result for its obvious fix.

**F27 — recovery sub-case 4 is unreachable.** The guards for sub-cases 3 and 4 in `handlePrepareReply` are identical, so the documented TryPreAccept path never runs. The focused test constructs “one PREACCEPTED reply, all equal, no leader reply” (`f/2` for N=5) and observes phase 1 restarting instead of TryPreAccept ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/audit_recovery_subcase4_output.txt)).

The naive repair in `diagnostic_fix15/` makes the branch reachable and passes the focused test, but the 500-seed campaign becomes **321 pass / 85 SKIP / 94 NOOP / 0 divergence** — proposals disappear entirely in 85 seeds ([output](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_00-19-47-swiftpaxos_epaxos-baseline/work/diagnostic_fix15_campaign500_output.txt)). It is retained as a negative validation; the corrected guard needs the TLA/upstream reference rather than the inferred `f/2` threshold.

The captured suite is now **42 failing finding tests and 5 passing controls**; the report documents **27 findings**. `run_audit.sh` asserts those counts, reruns the 100/500/1,000-seed campaigns and loss classifier, builds, and confirms the captured source is unchanged.
